description: Download media files from one chat (by id or @username) to a local directory and return the absolute paths of newly downloaded files. Use extensions (csv, e.g. 'xlsx,pdf') to fetch only certain file types; since_id for 'everything new after message X'; last_n for 'the latest N media messages' (default 100). Already-present files are skipped (--skip-same).

chat.description: Chat id or @username/domain (as shown by tg_chats)

extensions.description: Comma-separated file extensions to include, e.g. 'xlsx,pdf'

last_n.description: How many recent media messages to consider (default 100)

since_id.description: Only messages with id > since_id (overrides last_n)

name: tg_download
title: Download Telegram media from a chat
